recognize_zh: 抹片中的淋巴樣細胞核為圓形至卵圓、染色質均勻，胞質豐富淡藍灰色，但邊緣平滑、幾乎看不到典型的毛狀突起（hairless）；骨髓切片呈瀰漫性浸潤、細胞間距均勻（fried-egg 樣），免疫染色呈膜陽性，仍需以免疫表型確認為毛細胞白血病。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval, slightly eccentric nuclei and homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with smooth or broad, flat borders and few or no fine hair-like projections in panel A
Other smear (B) shows cells with fuzzy, irregular cytoplasmic margins
Bone marrow biopsy: diffuse, monotonous interstitial infiltrate with evenly spaced nuclei and clear cytoplasmic halos
Immunohistochemistry: strong membranous staining of virtually all infiltrating cells
describe_en: Smears show medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm; in one preparation the cytoplasmic borders are smooth and largely lack the fine hair-like projections classically expected, while another shows irregular fuzzy margins. The bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate with evenly spaced nuclei and clear cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous staining of the neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia with inconspicuous hairy projections, and diagnosis should rely on flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123), annexin A1 and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus, are CD25-negative, annexin A1-negative and BRAF V600E wild type, and usually present with leukocytosis.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short villi, a nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow pattern and lack CD103/CD25/annexin A1 coexpression.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and fine azurophilic granules and express CD14/CD64 rather than B-cell markers.
Mast cells show granular cytoplasm and spindling with tryptase and CD117 positivity, whereas hairy cells are CD20-positive B cells.
